description: This Swift file defines a controller for displaying lightweight, in-app toast notifications on macOS without using the native Notification Center. It includes classes for managing the notification overlay window, its presentation and dismissal logic, and SwiftUI views for rendering notification content.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton controller class managing in-app toast notifications, providing methods to present and dismiss notifications with animation and layout handling.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays a notification with specified title and body, optionally auto-dismissing after a delay.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if it hasn't been created yet.

methods.name: presentWindow
methods.description: Configures and displays the notification window.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the position and size of the notification window on screen.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the necessary height of the notification based on content.
